title: IVG Pro 12 Pineapple Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Pineapple Ice IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods serve up a juicy Pineapple flavour with a brisk Menthol finish. The fruit brings tropical sweetness with just a hint of tang, while the cool exhale adds balance and freshness. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill system auto-tops the pod as you vape, supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. No coil changes or refills required. With mesh coil technology and smooth MTL performance, these pods are made exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit . How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
